name: fingerprint-version
//: Proves llmlint's own version is part of `llmlint fingerprint` through the real CLI: the workspace's built llmlint and a second build from a scratch copy of this repository with only Cargo.toml's package version changed print different digests, while one build agrees with itself. Its own project, and its own `version-proof` target outside the gate tiers, because it compiles a second llmlint (into target/fingerprint-version): neither the e2e suite nor the affected `test` sweep pays for that build; its own workflow runs it instead. Edges: llmlint is the crate it builds and runs, llmlint-mock-oneharness the stand-in harness it runs against.

version-proof.//: Outside the gate tiers: it compiles a second llmlint, so no `nx affected -t test` / `run-many -t test` sweep may select it. Run with `just test-fingerprint-version`; the Fingerprint version workflow (.github/workflows/fingerprint-version.yml) runs it on every pull request and push to main that touches these inputs. Its inputs are everything that can change its result and nothing else: the crate's sources and the assets it embeds, the manifest and lockfile, the build configuration, the stand-in harness, and this test. A repo-root edit outside them (README, justfile) replays it from the cache.
